newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials eased late Monday, pushing prices lower in tandem with weakening futures prices, traders said.
Trade was thin as traders in the Chicago and Group Three markets assessed positions for March deliveries and waited for the heating oil and unleaded futures to bottom out, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline for March deliveries was talked 2.75/3.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded in Chicago and 0.75/1.0 cents under the print in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel for March deliveries remained 5.75/6.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago and 4.0/4.25 cents over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel was unchanged at bids 3.0 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 2.25 cents over in Group Three, traders said.

The Williams Pipeline system, a key barometer of inventories in the Group Three market, opened the week with a 36-day supply of low sulphur diesel and 25-day supply of unleaded gasoline on hand, traders said.
